title: PregOutfit 솔로 #044 · 임산부커브드바스트 · 빨강 라이크라 크로스랩 비키니 · glossy white lips
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her mid 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a bold cheeky grin, cool ash-brown hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real pores, real living eyes, 150 bars piercings set with sapphires in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing a single piece of mixed-metal an anklet. Wearing a minimal cross-wrap string micro bikini made entirely of matte red stretch lycra: a cross-wrap top made of two narrow flat matte red stretch lycra bands, each only two fingers wide, that start at the sides of her ribs, rise diagonally across each breast, cross in an X at the center of her chest and tie behind her neck, and a low-rise string micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque matte red stretch lycra triangle on thin side strings tied at her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her pregnant belly fully bare above it. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme matte red stretch lycra extreme platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
